mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bar_count (bar_id, fan_count) VALUES (#{barId}, 0) ON CONFLICT (bar_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: INSERT INTO tb_bar_count (bar_id, fan_count) VALUES (#{barId}, 1) ON CONFLICT (bar_id) DO UPDATE SET fan_count = tb_bar_count.fan_count + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE tb_bar_count SET fan_count = GREATEST(fan_count - 1, 0), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE bar_id = #{barId}
